title: Alaska intrastate gas — Kenai/Beluga and the Anchorage system
source_ladder: Alaska Regulatory Commission (RCA) filings and tariff dockets for Harvest Alaska / Hilcorp (Kenai Beluga Pipeline) and ENSTAR Natural Gas Company (Anchorage system); Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas right-of-way lease records (gives the original commissioning year the Date_logic flags turn on); Alaska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission; PHMSA operator annual reports for the gas transmission mileage; Hilcorp/Harvest and ENSTAR company pages; Alaska Journal of Commerce and Alaska Beacon for in-service reporting. These are intrastate and pre-date most digital records — a 1960s-70s original in-service date will come from the RCA/DNR record or a retrospective, not a press release.
